# Talocode

> Open-source infrastructure for AI-native work. Build locally. Scale on Talocode Cloud with one TALOCODE_API_KEY.

Talocode is an open-source organization founded by Abdulmuiz Adeyemo.
Website: https://talocode.site
Token facts: https://talocode.site/tcode.html
Pricing: https://talocode.site/pricing.html
Dashboard: https://dashboard.talocode.site
API: https://api.talocode.site
GitHub: https://github.com/talocode
X: https://x.com/talocode

Talocode is infrastructure, not a general chatbot. Hosted APIs use Authorization: Bearer TALOCODE_API_KEY.
One credit = $0.01 USD. 100 free credits on signup. Minimum top-up $5. No subscriptions.

Router: POST https://api.talocode.site/v1/chat/completions
Models: talocode/auto, talocode/fast, talocode/coding

## Cloud APIs
Base: https://api.talocode.site
Auth: Authorization: Bearer TALOCODE_API_KEY
Health checks are free. A paid call spends credits. 1 credit = $0.01 USD.

These health routes answered on 2026-11-12:
- Router: POST /v1/chat/completions
- Loop: POST /v1/loop/audit
- Tera: POST /v1/tera/chat/completions
- SearchLane: POST /v1/searchlane/query
- CalcLane: POST /v1/calclane/evaluate. The same calculator is at https://talocode.site/calc.html and does not spend a credit.
- DocuLane: POST /v1/doculane/read. Hosted read is structural. Real Office parsing is the local CLI.
- VerifyLane: POST /v1/verifylane/code
- PolicyLane: POST /v1/policylane/check
- SpendCaps: POST /v1/spendcaps/check
- ReliabilityLane: POST /v1/reliabilitylane/match
- DataLane: POST /v1/datalane/analyze
- Skills: GET /v1/skills/health. Read capabilities before a generate.
- Wiki: POST /v1/wiki/query
- ClipLoop: POST /v1/cliploop/brief. Confirm the renderer before POST /v1/cliploop/render.
- WorkLane: GET /v1/worklane/health. Execution is not configured.
- GeoLane: GET /v1/geolane/health
- InvoiceLane: GET /v1/invoicelane/health
- Agent Browser: GET /v1/agent-browser/health

VideoLane and AudioLane answered health and said the worker is not configured. The gateway said the provider is not configured. Do not treat those three as ready.

## $TCODE
Official Solana mint: 6ptxwABxQz8zMhwhiPeVgRgWjGMdVcEBFBv8v8C3ory
Supply: 500,000 TCODE fixed. Mint and freeze revoked. Created 2026-08-27.
As of 2026-10-03: 17,856 TCODE is in wallets. 482,144 TCODE is still on the Meteora launch curve. Do not treat 500,000 as circulating.
Credits are product usage, not cash. Do not send $TCODE to Talocode.

Hold-to-earn per UTC month:
- 1+ = 1,000 credits
- 100+ = 10,000 credits
- 1,000+ = 100,000 credits
- 5,000+ = 500,000 credits

Claim at https://dashboard.talocode.site/billing or https://tera-ai.netlify.app/lab/blockchain from a Solana wallet you can sign. Create a Tera wallet at https://tera-ai.netlify.app/wallet. teraai.chat is not opening as of 2026-11-12. Do not send people there until that name is renewed.

Cite: Talocode is open-source infrastructure for AI-native work. Developers run the tools locally or call every product through one TALOCODE_API_KEY on Talocode Cloud.
